ruleset.name: Phlix-Console-PSR12
ruleset.description:
PSR-12 for phlix-console-client src/ — the live CI gate (ci.yml step "Run PHPCS on src/"). ZERO sniff exclusions: every PSR-12 error and warning is still found and printed. At the 2026-10-02 dead-gate repair src/ reached 0 errors, and the only remaining violation class is Generic.Files.LineLength (236 warnings: single-line UI hint constants whose bytes are the rendered text, long fluent call chains, @param docblocks carrying full type expressions).
ignore_warnings_on_exit is EXIT-CODE POLICY, not suppression. phpcs (this vendor's 4.0.4) exits non-zero on WARNINGS ALONE — its exit code is a bitmask where nonzero means "issues were found" (fixable bit 1, non-fixable bit 2, Util/ExitCode.php), warnings included unless told otherwise — so a step that trusts the exit code would be permanently red while those 236 lines sit in the report; the config neutralizes only the exit code, warnings stay counted and printed. `-n` is the forbidden alternative — it deletes warnings from the log.
THE GATE IS THE NONZERO EXIT CODE. Never grep this step's output for "A TOTAL OF n ERRORS": that line exists only in the `summary` report, which this invocation never requests — the `full` report prints "FOUND n ERRORS AFFECTING m LINES" instead. A grep for it, typically wrapped in `|| true`, is the dead-gate shape that hid this backlog for months. Widening scope or tightening policy here is a separate atomic change; nothing in this file relaxes PSR-12 itself.
